existing_candidates.checkJSON: Reuse allObjects duplicate refusal and new-field aliases at depth3; no validator addition.
existing_candidates.wrapPages: Not changed; exact menu separator contracts forbid wrapping instead of silently changing choices.

reach: patch_test.go existing read-only authoring fit block
compatibility: Old unambiguous valid profiles complete-byte parity. Deliberately reject all duplicate profile object keys and ASCII/Unicode aliases of required_line_breaks. Null/absent means legacy.
